directionEditPrompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Input image is the exact EDIT TARGET. Perform only a HORIZONTAL MIRROR / LEFT-RIGHT FLIP of the entire provided image, so the wooden vehicle now points to the RIGHT. Preserve the entire artwork, proportions, silhouette, color, painted parts, wood grain, window grooves, wheel sizes, lighting pattern (mirrored with the pixels), layout, scale, canvas dimensions (1536x1024), transparent margins, and original alpha transparency. No redesign, no reimagining, no new details, no cropping, no relighting. The requested output is simply the horizontally mirrored original asset. Keep background genuinely transparent; no backdrop, checkerboard, glow, shadow or text.

assets.designPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a single transparent PNG asset for the Drive Coach app, part of a set of five visibly DIFFERENT vehicle classes.
Visual references: image 1 contributes tactile natural pale wood upper blocks and wheels plus a colored lower chassis; image 2 contributes bold, minimal, geometric toy proportions and strong category-specific silhouettes. References are style only. Do not reproduce their logos, lettering, numbers, backgrounds, perspective or vehicle arrangements.
ART DIRECTION: collectible designer wooden toy, reduced to a few sculptural hand-sanded blocks. Intentionally simple and graphic, beautiful real wood grain, slightly chamfered edges. The cabin is predominantly UNPAINTED PALE MAPLE, wheel discs and axle pins are NATURAL WOOD. Colored portion is matte thin paint on the LOWER BODY only, so the object still unmistakably feels wooden. At least half the visible vehicle should be natural wood. Use very minimal small dark incised window indications only where needed to read the vehicle; never large dark brown window panels. No realistic pressed-metal bodywork, photorealistic car detailing, door handles, mirrors, glass, rubber, metallic wheel rims, headlights facing camera, or dense panel seams.
CAMERA: strict pure LEFT-FACING SIDE PROFILE, perfectly perpendicular orthographic side elevation at the center height of the car. No visible front or rear face, no top of hood or roof, no three-quarter perspective, no far-side wheels. EXACTLY TWO near-side circular wood disc wheels with a central wooden dowel, both on the same horizontal line. It must read clearly as a side silhouette at small UI sizes.
CANVAS: landscape 3:2, 1536x1024 if available. Whole car, no cropping. Place wheels' bottom on common baseline at 79% of canvas height. The remaining background is true transparent alpha, with no ground plane, no shadows outside the object, no glow, no vignette, no backdrop. Clean cutout.
LIGHT: soft studio illumination showing the tactile wood texture and small edge bevels, natural matte finish. This is a high-end toy product illustration, not a flat vector drawing.
ABSOLUTE CONSTRAINTS: ONE car only. No words, lettering, logos, numbers, branding, badges, racing stripes, background, pedestal, people or collage. Preserve the specific silhouette dimensions and distinctive class features requested below.

CATEGORY: MICRO CITY HATCHBACK. Make a very SHORT, CHUBBY, ROUND pebble-shaped little car. Length-to-total-height ratio around 1.7:1. A simple natural maple rounded dome cabin, almost no protruding hood, near-vertical rear, a tiny stubby mustard-yellow lower chassis with rounded ends, two relatively large wood disc wheels spaced CLOSE together. Cute upright compact silhouette, like a small egg on wheels, very obviously the shortest member. No roof rack, no trunk, no elongated body. Lower body paint MUSTARD YELLOW. Natural wood dome has a single simple small side window indication, without splitting into many panels. On the shared canvas the car occupies only about 55% of width and 47% of height; leave generous transparent side margins so it remains physically smaller than the other classes.
